Which of the following options are valid methods for handling missing values in Data Wrangler? (Choose TWO)

options.text: Impute missing values using the mean or median of the column
Drop all rows that contain missing values

Use interpolation to estimate missing values based on related features

questions.domain: ML Solution Monitoring, Maintenance, and Security
questions.promptHtml: A company needs to ensure that its machine learning models are ethically developed by reducing bias and detecting potential vulnerabilities in the output. How can Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth help in this process?
questions.promptText: A company needs to ensure that its machine learning models are ethically developed by reducing bias and detecting potential vulnerabilities in the output. How can Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth help in this process?

options.text: By using Ground Truth's fully automated labeling system to eliminate all bias from the training data.
By leveraging Ground Truth’s human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism to review and correct model outputs for bias and vulnerabilities.
By exclusively relying on third-party vendors to detect bias and vulnerabilities in model outputs.
By using Ground Truth only for labeling data, leaving bias detection to other AWS services like SageMaker Clarify.

correctText: By leveraging Ground Truth’s human-in-the-loop feedback mechanism to review and correct model outputs for bias and vulnerabilities.

questions.domain: ML Model Development
questions.promptHtml:
A data scientist needs to implement a custom machine learning algorithm that is not natively supported by Amazon SageMaker. They want to modularize their code to separate the model definition, training, and inference logic into distinct components, and they need to include additional Python libraries for the project.

Which of the following strategies should they follow?
questions.promptText:
A data scientist needs to implement a custom machine learning algorithm that is not natively supported by Amazon SageMaker. They want to modularize their code to separate the model definition, training, and inference logic into distinct components, and they need to include additional Python libraries for the project. 

Which of the following strategies should they follow?

options.text: Write the entire code in one Python script, and SageMaker will automatically handle dependencies without any need to modularize the code.
Use SageMaker Script Mode to modularize the code across multiple Python scripts, specifying the entry point script and including additional dependencies via a requirements.txt file.
Build a custom Docker container from scratch, package the code, libraries, and dependencies manually, and deploy it in SageMaker.
Use SageMaker only for built-in algorithms, as it does not support custom libraries or complex modularization in Script Mode.

correctText: Use SageMaker Script Mode to modularize the code across multiple Python scripts, specifying the entry point script and including additional dependencies via a requirements.txt file.

questions.domain: Deployment and Orchestration of ML Workflows
questions.promptHtml: A company is developing a machine learning model using a proprietary machine learning framework that is not supported by SageMaker. They decide to use SageMaker's "bring your own container" approach to handle both training and inference. What advantages does this approach provide, and which tasks are still the company’s responsibility?
questions.promptText: A company is developing a machine learning model using a proprietary machine learning framework that is not supported by SageMaker. They decide to use SageMaker's "bring your own container" approach to handle both training and inference. What advantages does this approach provide, and which tasks are still the company’s responsibility?

options.text: SageMaker will fully manage the environment, and the company only needs to provide their training code.
The company gains full control over the training and inference environment but must manage the Docker image creation, container configuration, and deployment.
SageMaker will automatically handle container creation and distribution, but the company must manage data preprocessing steps.
The company can still use SageMaker’s built-in training algorithms, and only needs to customize the inference process with the custom container.

correctText: The company gains full control over the training and inference environment but must manage the Docker image creation, container configuration, and deployment.

questions.domain: ML Model Development
questions.promptHtml: A data scientist is working with a large dataset that cannot fit into the memory of a single machine and decides to use distributed training in Amazon SageMaker. The model is small enough to fit in memory on each worker, but the data is too large for one machine. Which distributed training approach should they use, and how will SageMaker manage the process?
questions.promptText: A data scientist is working with a large dataset that cannot fit into the memory of a single machine and decides to use distributed training in Amazon SageMaker. The model is small enough to fit in memory on each worker, but the data is too large for one machine. Which distributed training approach should they use, and how will SageMaker manage the process?

options.text: Model parallelism, where the model is split across different workers, and each worker trains a portion of the model.
Data parallelism, where the dataset is split into chunks across multiple workers, and each worker trains the same model on its chunk of data.
Data parallelism, where the model is divided into smaller components, and each component is trained on a different machine.
Model parallelism, where each worker trains the same data on a subset of the model layers.

correctText: Data parallelism, where the dataset is split into chunks across multiple workers, and each worker trains the same model on its chunk of data.

questions.promptText:
A company is training a deep learning model with billions of parameters, which is too large to fit on a single machine. They decide to use model parallelism on Amazon SageMaker.

options.text: SageMaker Model Monitor automatically manages and optimizes the model splitting process across multiple GPUs.
SageMaker’s Model Parallelism Library automatically splits the model across multiple GPUs or machines, based on the model architecture and available memory.

correctText: SageMaker’s Model Parallelism Library automatically splits the model across multiple GPUs or machines, based on the model architecture and available memory.

questions.domain: ML Model Development
questions.promptHtml:
A data scientist at a healthcare company is tasked with building a machine learning model to predict patient outcomes based on clinical data. The team decides to test different algorithms, hyperparameters, and feature sets to find the most accurate model. To manage and compare these variations, the data scientist decides to use SageMaker Experiments.

Which of the following strategies will BEST allow the team to track and compare their experiments, ensuring reproducibility and organized management of model configurations?
questions.promptText:
A data scientist at a healthcare company is tasked with building a machine learning model to predict patient outcomes based on clinical data. The team decides to test different algorithms, hyperparameters, and feature sets to find the most accurate model. To manage and compare these variations, the data scientist decides to use SageMaker Experiments. 

Which of the following strategies will BEST allow the team to track and compare their experiments, ensuring reproducibility and organized management of model configurations?

options.text: Create a single trial with one configuration and manually adjust hyperparameters each time for new tests.

Use SageMaker Experiments to organize model runs into trials under a single experiment, where each trial logs configurations and metrics, enabling easy comparison of different models and hyperparameters.
Use SageMaker Ground Truth to label datasets and organize each training run as a separate trial component under different experiments.
Log every hyperparameter and configuration change manually to a spreadsheet and compare the metrics offline after each run.

correctText: Use SageMaker Experiments to organize model runs into trials under a single experiment, where each trial logs configurations and metrics, enabling easy comparison of different models and hyperparameters.

questions.promptText:
A telecommunications company is building a machine learning model to predict customer churn. Use SageMaker Ground Truth to create labeled features and store them in SageMaker Feature Store’s offline store for real-time predictions.

questions.promptText:
